prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just leave my name off, if that's okay. You already have the claim file.
Q: That's fine for this recording. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was turning left off a main road into a shopping center parking lot.
Q: What time of day was it?
A: Mid-afternoon, I think. The sun was bright, so visibility was decent.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you began your turn.
A: I had my left signal on and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. There was a gap, so I started to turn, and then a vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see that vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I looked, but it came up quickly. I think it may have been in the lane close to the median.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My lower back took most of it. It tightened up right away, and by that evening I could barely bend over.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider since the accident?
A: I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy. I've been going twice a week.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes, it's better than it was, but I still get stiffness when I sit for long periods or lift anything heavy.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and I was stopped at the point of the turn when the other car hit me. I'm hoping this gets resolved so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
